Name: Wedding Anniversaries - Mateo (Sword and Sorcery)
Author: Roonya
Description:
This is a dialogue add-on for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Wedding Anniversaries[/url] which gives [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Mateo[/url] special anniversary dialogue when they're married to the player. It includes reminder dialogue 7 days before as well as [b]new dialogue[/b] on the day itself, plus a [b]gift[/b] - all tailored to the character.

Wedding Anniversaries already functions out of the box for custom NPCs, but the dialogue is pretty generic (by necessity!). If you're a bit Mateo-crazy like me, you'd rather have something more reflective of their personality.

If you're a cruel, cruel spouse who maintains less than 10 hearts in your marriage, the new dialogue (and gift) will reflect that as well. [i]@anyone who actually does this to Mateo, [s]I will find you and spank you[/s]  thank you for validating the time I spent writing the bad marriage dialogue. It was heartbreaking. But also fun.[/i]

[b]To make this work, you need all of the following:
[/b]Latest[b] [/b]versions of[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Wedding Anniversaries[/url] and its requirements [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url] and its requirements (won't list them all here), and this mod right here.

You will get:

3 possible reminder dialogues, 5 possible heart-warming anniversary dialogues (randomized by Content Patcher)
3 possible bad reminder dialogues, 3 possible heart-breaking bad anniversary dialogues. You monster.

The list of possible gifts will be included in the articles section, since it's spoilery, I guess?

[size=1]Non-serious disclaimer: I may have gotten carried away with some of these lines. Some are pretty suggestive - the same level of suggestive as S&S - at least that was the aim ;)[b] [/b][size=1]They're also rather longer than the vanilla bachelor/ettes Wedding Anniversaries dialogue lines, but I figure anyone who bothers downloading a mod like this one won't mind that, right? Right??

[/size][/size][b]Many, many thanks to 

Kantrip [/b]- For Wedding Anniversaries; for making it so accessible to create such a patch AND for taking the time to implement my suggestion!! <3
[b]DestyNova [/b]- For creating Mateo and very generously granting me permission for this fanfic right here *melts*
[b]Pathoschild [/b]- For SMAPI and Content Patcher, legend
[b]ConcernedApe [/b]- He's a pretty cool person, I hear

I might in the future add a couple of lines that reference the player's children with Mateo, but we'll see. Feels like I've already taken enough liberties with what should just have been a small fluff mod anyways!

Translations welcome (no AI)! [size=1]I'm too lazy to do any myself hahhaha I want to play the game now[/size]
